codeReview.summary: The feature does move schema setup into versioned SQL and wires golang-migrate into NewState(), but it does not fully satisfy the stated validation contract. A blocking issue remains because the new Go test file reintroduces the exact CREATE TABLE literal that VAL-BH-002 requires to be absent outside migration files.

issues.description: The test embeds the exact `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` literal in Go code (and repeats it at line 165). VAL-BH-002 explicitly requires `grep -rn "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS\|ALTER TABLE.*ADD COLUMN" backend/janus-api/internal/` to return zero matches outside migration files, so this implementation still fails that assertion.

The prior inline migrator also executed legacy cleanup for `message_inbox`, `message_outbox`, and `message_queue`, but the new initial migration omits that behavior entirely. Fresh databases are fine, yet existing installs no longer get the same cleanup semantics that `State.migrate()` previously provided.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The backend-worker skill says to write tests first and prove a failing red phase, but this worker implemented migrations and migrate.go before creating migrate_test.go while handoff.skillFeedback still reported followedProcedure=true.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript skeleton shows migration files and `internal/core/migrate.go` created before `internal/core/migrate_test.go`; `.factory/skills/backend-worker/SKILL.md` step 3 requires TDD first.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The shared command catalog does not expose any repo-level migration up/down command even though the validation contract depends on running migrations directly.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Validation contract VAL-BH-001 and VAL-BH-014 require `migrate up` / `migrate down` execution, but `E:\Janus\.factory\services.yaml` only lists install/test/build/lint commands and no migration helper.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Migration-specific implementation gotchas are not captured in shared knowledge: the pgx v5 golang-migrate driver path and Go embed requiring migration files to live at or below the embedding package.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript skeleton shows web searches for the pgx v5 driver package and a mid-stream move of the migrations directory into `internal/core/migrations` so `//go:embed` would work.

summary: Reviewed commit 5801d72 plus the worker handoff and transcript skeleton. The feature adds golang-migrate with embedded SQL migrations, but the review fails because `internal/core/migrate_test.go` still contains `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` literals in Go code, which violates VAL-BH-002's required grep check. I also noted an omitted legacy cleanup step and several shared-state gaps for future workers.
